title: グランドライブ、スタート！

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes… yes, understood! Please connect the live feeds from all of the stages.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's a resounding success across the entire venue. Part two is just about to start, and with it…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It's time for "Girls' Legend U."
choice_data_list: …The moment we've all been waiting for, huh.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes, the performance will take place not only here at stage A, but also at stages B and C… all stages at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Every performer across the event will be singing at the same time, and every fan will be cheering along.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe. The technicians put a lot of hard work into this, so I'm certain it'll be a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: For the girls, the fans… and you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We made this concert together, and everyone's the star!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm a little bit nervous, but it's okay, because I'm excited too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to make this an unforgettable show for all the people who came to watch us!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Whether it's springtime or summer or autumn or winter, burn with hope and ambition…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …And run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Heh, this song's funny, isn't it? In the end, it somehow comes back to running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What else would you expect from a song about us? I think the lyrics turned out great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Deep breaths…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Here we go, everyone! Let's make sure our song and emotions are heard!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Woo.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You will gain power from this performance, I'm sure of it! Now go expand your potential, strengthen the utility of your bonds, and overcome your limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That goes for you too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We can't end it here—we're just getting started! C'mon, let's sing "Girls' Legend U" together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is to let "Girls' Legend U" play.
